title: Computational Staining of Pathology Images to Study the Tumor Microenvironment in Lung Cancer

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Computational Staining of Pathology Images to Study the Tumor Microenvironment in Lung Cancer》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The spatial organization of different types of cells in tumor tissues reveals important information about the tumor microenvironment (TME).

evidence.text: The spatial organization of different types of cells in tumor tissues reveals important information about the tumor microenvironment (TME).

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Computational Staining of Pathology Images to Study the Tumor Microenvironment in Lung Cancer》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】In summary, we demonstrate that the spatial organization of different cell types is predictive of patient survival and associated with the gene expression of biological pathways.

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】SIGNIFICANCE: These findings present a deep learning-based analysis tool to study the TME in pathology images and demonstrate that the cell spatial organization is predictive of patient survival and is associated with gene expression.See related commentary by Rodriguez-Antolin, p. 1912.
